findings:
## Problem

When observation-watcher invokes Claude Code, there is currently no requirement for Claude Code to produce a run report or sync its work to git. This means:

- We cannot audit what Claude Code did in response to an observation
- File edits may sit uncommitted locally with no record of what changed
- There is no ISO-timestamped artifact we can review or roll back to
- The feedback loop is effectively a black box after observation-watcher fires

## Required Changes to observation-watcher

The Claude Code prompt that observation-watcher constructs and passes must include the following mandatory instructions:

### 1. Write a full run report
At the end of every run, Claude Code must write a report file to:

  var/claude-code/runs/YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.json

File name must be ISO 8601 

suggested_fix:
